goal: A Vite+React dashboard that renders the kanban board, agent status panel, goal submission form, and lessons feed, all driven live from the backend over WebSocket without page refresh
summary: Phase 3 delivered the real-time React dashboard. Data layer: web/src/api.ts (typed REST client getState/getAgents/getLessons/postGoal with verbatim server {error} propagation; connectWs with same-origin ws(s)://location.host/ws, 500ms->5000ms jittered backoff, status callbacks, intentional close) and web/src/store.ts (React-free reducer store: snapshot/event/ws.status actions, id-keyed upserts preserving order, lesson prepend, structural-equality no-ops preserving references, useSyncExternalStore-compatible; 24 tests). Components: Board.tsx (3-column kanban with counts, failed-in-Done with distinct badge, role/status/assignee badges, activity.slice(-2) thought-chain tail, data-testids) and AgentPanel.tsx (roster with status pills and current-task resolution) with 9 render tests incl. seeded-store WS re-render; GoalForm.tsx (POST /goals via injected wrapper, disabled on empty/in-flight, verbatim 400 errors in role=alert) + LessonsFeed.tsx (newest-first, lesson/pitfall badge tints) + App.tsx (singleton store + StrictMode-safe hydration+connectWs, conn indicator, 2fr|1fr composition) with 13 more tests incl. the criterion-critical App test proving WS events mutate the rendered board without refresh. Styling: handcrafted dark operator-console styles.css (7.01 kB bundled), dark color-scheme index.html, status/role color coding, responsive grid, reduced-motion support. Verified: web suite 46/46 (web total incl. sanity), root 113/113, vite build exit 0 with css asset, typecheck+lint exit 0, and an INSPECTED live run: real npm run dev (server:3001 + vite:5173 proxy) with POST /goals through the proxy -> 201 and a verbatim 38-event WS transcript ending goal.status done with 4 lessons and 4 terminal tasks, page HTML + dev styles confirmed, clean teardown.
stepSummaries:
1. Implement web/src/api.ts (REST client + WS client with reconnect/backoff) and web/src/store.ts (reducer store applying WsEvents: task.updated, agent.status, lesson.created, goal.status) with store.test.ts feeding scripted event sequences and asserting resulting state [verified]
  2. Implement kanban Board (Todo/In Progress/Done columns of task cards with role + activity badge) and AgentPanel (per-agent role, status, current task) rendering from the store, with a component render test against a seeded store [verified]
  3. Implement GoalForm (POSTs to /goals, disables on empty input, shows 400 errors) and LessonsFeed (live-appended lesson entries), wired through the store/api layer with a test asserting submit issues POST /goals [verified]
  4. Layout & styling pass: dark operator-console aesthetic, responsive grid (board | agents | lessons), status color coding, activity log strip per card for the thought-chain feel [verified]
